What happens to my Instagram when I die?

Short answer: Instagram memorialises an account when it receives proof of death, such as an obituary. Nobody can log into a memorialised account, and its posts stay visible to the same audience. Verified immediate family can instead ask for the account to be removed, using documents such as a death certificate. Instagram doesn't give out passwords.

Key facts

  • Memorialise: anyone, with proof of death
  • Remove: verified immediate family
  • No login access for anyone
  • Back up your own photos via Download your information

How do I prepare my Instagram account?

  1. Anyone can submit a memorialisation request with proof of death.
  2. Immediate family can request removal with documents such as a death certificate.
  3. Back up your own photos now using Accounts Centre → 'Download your information'.

Read the official policy ↗

What documents do heirs need?

  • Memorialisation: proof of death, such as an obituary link
  • Removal: documents such as the death certificate and proof you're immediate family or the estate representative

How long does it take?

Instagram reviews each request; no fixed timeframe is published.

What can't be recovered?

  • Direct messages
  • Login access

Frequently asked questions

What happens to my Instagram when I die?

Instagram memorialises an account when it receives proof of death, such as an obituary. Nobody can log into a memorialised account, and its posts stay visible to the same audience. Verified immediate family can instead ask for the account to be removed, using documents such as a death certificate. Instagram doesn't give out passwords.

Can family get into an Instagram account?

No. Instagram doesn't give out login access to memorialised accounts.

Does Instagram have a legacy contact?

Instagram supports memorialisation and removal requests. Check the current Accounts Centre settings for options.

How do I save my Instagram photos?

Use Accounts Centre → Your information and permissions → Download your information.

Can anyone request memorialisation?

Yes, with proof of death. Removal is limited to verified immediate family.
